title: How much does the top fifth hold?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the Pareto shape behind concentration.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the Pareto shape behind concentration affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines WealthShare, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the Pareto shape behind concentration in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
